tiers.name: Free
tiers.limits: Unlimited basic links; current public page does not state a numeric analytics-history limit.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.limits: 1 Linktree profile; unlimited basic links; basic analytics; 9% seller fee on digital products.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.limits: 1 Linktree profile; advanced analytics and integrations; 7-day trial.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.limits: 1 Linktree profile; advanced analytics/export, social scheduling and unlimited Instagram auto-replies; 7-day trial.

tiers.name: Agency / Enterprise
tiers.limits: Custom team seats and contract; numeric limits are not public.

pricing.freeTierCaps: Unlimited basic links; numeric analytics-retention and audience limits are not published on the live plan card.
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual; Pro and Premium include 7-day trials; cancel anytime
pricing.hiddenCosts: Starter takes a 9% seller fee; Premium lists 0%, while transaction/payment-processing fees can still apply. Other plan-level seller fees were not exposed in the live comparison.

verdictSummary: A static page. The most obviously one-shottable thing on this list.
name: Linktree Pro
notes: A static page. The most obviously one-shottable thing on this list.

alternatives.name: Carrd
alternatives.desc: Three free one-page sites; your custom domain and the last scrap of vanity still cost money.

facts.install: Hosted browser signup and visual editor
facts.dataFormat: Site definitions and uploaded media live in Carrd's cloud and are published to a Carrd URL; downloading unminified site source is a Pro Plus feature rather than part of the free account.
facts.gapVsPaid: Carrd's free plan has a 50-element limit, Carrd branding, no custom domain, and no built-in click analytics or forms, so it cannot reproduce the useful Pro extras without paying.

alternatives.name: LinkStack
alternatives.desc: Linktree without the landlord: editor, themes and click stats, all in one Docker stack.

facts.install: Upload the release to a PHP 8.1+ web host and run browser setup, or use the official Docker image
facts.dataFormat: Profiles, links, themes, users, and click data live in SQLite by default or MySQL; uploaded images, configuration, and the database live under writable persistent application directories.
facts.gapVsPaid: LinkStack can reproduce the page and click counts, but the user must host, secure, back up, and update it and loses Linktree's integrations, marketplace, and managed reliability.
facts.setupBlocker: The first obstacle is supplying a PHP/Docker host with writable storage, HTTPS, backups, and upgrades; public community instances remove setup but put the data on someone else's server.

alternatives.name: Linktree Free
alternatives.desc: The same static page with unlimited basic links for zero dollars; branding and serious analytics remain the rent.

facts.install: Hosted signup in a browser or the official mobile app
facts.dataFormat: Links, profile content, uploads, audience events, and analytics live in Linktree's cloud; exports are limited to the functions Linktree exposes rather than a portable site bundle.
facts.gapVsPaid: The free plan keeps Linktree branding and materially weaker analytics, customization, marketing integrations, and custom-domain control than Linktree Pro.

rejectedAlternatives.name: LittleLink
rejectedAlternatives.desc: Popular, healthy and still a template: a non-builder must edit files to change a link.

prompt:
Build me a link-in-bio page to replace Linktree. Requirements:

- A single static page: avatar, name, short bio, and a list of link buttons defined
  in one links.json file (title, url, optional emoji). Editing the JSON is the CMS.
- Clean mobile-first design, dark mode via prefers-color-scheme, subtle hover states.
  No framework needed · one HTML file with embedded CSS is fine, or Astro if you must.
- Add click tracking with zero third parties: each link goes through a /go/:slug
  redirect that appends a line to a local clicks.log (or a SQLite row) then 302s.
  Add a /stats page (basic-auth from .env) showing clicks per link.
- Proper OG tags + generated OG image so the page previews well when shared.
- Include deploy instructions for a plain VPS with Caddy or nginx.
